text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Today, Doto is running in her first graded race! Please, please, please don't let what I told her mess her up!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Doto got second place! She's so happy she comes to thank me for talking to her the other day! Oooh, her admiration for Opera O is just so… dazzling!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But her admiration doesn't come from a place of moe—it's her motivating drive! The feelings which drive Umamusume to run are more pure than I realized!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I must dash into that brilliant unknown world and learn its truths. There's nothing to it but to take another look at the Hyacinth Stakes!
